name: experiment
description: 'short_kick' (state/forcing kicks, 512 years) or 'long_rain' (one year of rain x (1+eps), 4580 years).

name: mode
description: Model configuration: 'A_nofire' (fire off) or 'C_fire_accumulate' (deterministic fire: yearly fire probability is summed, one full fire when the sum reaches 1).

name: member
description: Run name. 'member_000' is the unperturbed control; member_001 ... are perturbed runs (100 per mode in short_kick, 30 per mode in long_rain).

name: t
description: Years after the perturbation. short_kick: 0 (restart/kick year) to 512. long_rain: -20 to 4579 (20 unperturbed years before the rain perturbation at t = 0).

name: year
description: Simulation calendar year of LPJ-GUESS (spin-up ends at 2000).

name: cmass_Total
description: Total vegetation carbon (all PFTs). Short experiment only.

name: lai_Total
description: Leaf area index (all PFTs). Short experiment only.

name: dens_TrBE
description: Density of the tropical broadleaved evergreen tree PFT (TrBE). Short experiment only.

name: anpp_Total
description: Annual net primary production (all PFTs). Short experiment only.

name: cflux_NEE
description: Net ecosystem exchange, positive = carbon lost to the atmosphere. NEE = Veg + Repr + Soil + Fire + Est (LPJ-GUESS cflux.out); Repr, Fire and Est are not separate columns here. Present in both experiments.

name: cflux_Soil
description: Heterotrophic respiration (soil + litter). Short experiment only.

name: cflux_Veg
description: Vegetation carbon flux (= -NPP). Short experiment only.

name: npool_Total
description: Total ecosystem nitrogen (vegetation + litter + soil). Short experiment only.

name: u_sap_c
description: Short experiment only: kick of sapwood carbon, u in [-1, 1] (Latin-hypercube design, seed 7). Applied as x (1 + 0.01 u) in the restart year. Constant for the whole run; 0 for the control; empty in the long experiment.

name: u_heart_c
description: Short experiment only: kick of heartwood carbon, u in [-1, 1] (Latin-hypercube design, seed 7). Applied as x (1 + 0.01 u). Constant for the whole run; 0 for the control; empty in the long experiment.

name: u_tree_density
description: Short experiment only: kick of tree density, u in [-1, 1] (Latin-hypercube design, seed 7). Applied as x (1 + 0.01 u). Constant for the whole run; 0 for the control; empty in the long experiment.

name: u_litter_c
description: Short experiment only: kick of litter carbon, u in [-1, 1] (Latin-hypercube design, seed 7). Applied as x (1 + 0.01 u). Constant for the whole run; 0 for the control; empty in the long experiment.

name: u_soil_c_fast
description: Short experiment only: kick of fast soil carbon pool, u in [-1, 1] (Latin-hypercube design, seed 7). Applied as x (1 + 0.01 u). Constant for the whole run; 0 for the control; empty in the long experiment.

name: u_soil_c_slow
description: Short experiment only: kick of slow soil carbon pool, u in [-1, 1] (Latin-hypercube design, seed 7). Applied as x (1 + 0.01 u). Constant for the whole run; 0 for the control; empty in the long experiment.

name: u_soil_n
description: Short experiment only: kick of nitrogen in soil organic matter (not mineral N), u in [-1, 1] (Latin-hypercube design, seed 7). Applied as x (1 + 0.01 u). Constant for the whole run; 0 for the control; empty in the long experiment.

name: u_rain
description: Short experiment only: kick of precipitation of the restart year, u in [-1, 1] (Latin-hypercube design, seed 7). Applied as x (1 + 0.01 u). Constant for the whole run; 0 for the control; empty in the long experiment.

name: u_temp
description: Short experiment only: kick of temperature of the restart year, u in [-1, 1] (Latin-hypercube design, seed 7). Applied as + 0.1 K * u. Constant for the whole run; 0 for the control; empty in the long experiment.

name: u_sun
description: Short experiment only: kick of shortwave radiation of the restart year, u in [-1, 1] (Latin-hypercube design, seed 7). Applied as x (1 + 0.01 u). Constant for the whole run; 0 for the control; empty in the long experiment.

name: rain_eps
description: Long experiment only: eps of the rain perturbation (rain of year t = 0 multiplied by 1 + eps), eps = 0.01 * standard normal draw (numpy default_rng(42)); 0 for the control; empty in the short experiment.
